parsed.explanation: Locally protective: anti-discrimination in public accommodations, hate-crime reporting, self-declared state documents/X markers and a care shield law operate in this division. The combined regime is nevertheless constrained federally: binary passport policy upheld in November 2025, entry officers instructed to refuse on document/sex discrepancy and consider permanent fraud ineligibility for wilful misrepresentation, federal facilities barred by gender identity, and documented immigration-custody abuse. State law does not cancel federal border, federal-facility or federal-custody exposure, so everyday safety is materially below a purely protective jurisdiction.

entry_documents.exposure: Federal binary sex definition; X/new mismatched passports stopped Feb 2025, SCOTUS allowed Nov 2025. Cable: discrepancy/doubt -> refuse and seek evidence; suspected wilful misrepresentation -> consider permanent lifetime fraud ineligibility.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid to expiry; division issues X licences/IDs since 2019, self-declared birth-certificate amendment, confidential name changes.
entry_documents.interaction: Division document law does not bind federal entry screening; a discrepancy at the border can become refusal/fraud investigation before division protections apply.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Immigration custody: reported forced labour, beatings, solitary and severe sexual abuse of trans men. Federal corrections from 2026 adopted conversion-therapy model, hair-cutting, hormone removal; trans prisoner counts stopped 2025.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented for federal custody. Division hate-crime and anti-discrimination laws bind division agencies only.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Border discrepancy -> investigation/detention can lead to birth-sex federal custody/placement, negating division protections.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Federal order bars transgender people from government-funded single-sex facilities congruent with identity. Other-state bathroom bans/criminal trespass arrest do not apply here, but federal buildings remain exposed.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Division public-accommodation law since 2016, retained 67.8% in 2018, covers hotels, restaurants, shops, transport; no division bathroom ban documented.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Division law protects division/private venues; federal facility ban and possible federal pre-emption/uncertainty govern federal buildings and remain unresolved.

care_services.exposure: Federal executive orders target gender-affirming care for minors and funding; hospital subpoenas and proposed insurance bars documented nationally.
care_services.protection: Division shield law since 2022 and July 2022 codified gender-affirming care protections protect patients/providers where care lawful here but banned at home; conversion therapy on minors banned 2019.
care_services.interaction: Shield protects division care/provides from home-jurisdiction liability, but does not protect against federal border, medication, funding or custody actions.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Federal orders remove gender-identity materials/policies, counterterrorism strategy prioritises 'radically pro-transgender' groups; 2025 poll: 66% support assigned-sex document laws. Unrepealed division sodomy provisions unenforceable since 1974.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Division ranked Most Protective July 2026; employment/housing/public-accommodation protections since 2011-2016, hate-crime inclusion 2012.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Federal threat framing and document rules operate regardless of division ballot/local protections; unenforced sodomy text is tangential, not active enforcement.

minors_guardians.exposure: Federal orders direct investigation/prosecution over school social transition and restrict minor care/funding; 27 states ban youth care nationally.
minors_guardians.protection: Shield law and codified protections apply to visiting minor patients; division conversion-therapy ban; anti-bullying school procedures.
minors_guardians.interaction: A travelling minor/guardian can receive division care, but federal school, funding and entry-document rules may still affect travel, schooling and records.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Not documented. No division-specific trans-violence rate, police-profiling pattern or visitor incident documented; national public-opinion support for assigned-sex documents indicates friction, not documented violence.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Gender identity in division hate-crime statute from 2012 with collection/reporting unit and task force; public-accommodation protections provide civil recourse.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Division police/courts are the documented protective actor locally; federal law-enforcement framing does not document division street enforcement against visitors.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Passport suit and challenges to federal orders unresolved; several orders blocked/enjoined; lifetime-ineligibility waiver limited; timing/effect at travel uncertain.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Civil-liberties litigation, division courts/legislature protections, legal-aid FAQ on documents; no documented remedy for federal border refusal or custody in dossier.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Remedies may work in division civil matters but do not reliably restore entry, federal facilities or release from federal custody in real time.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar: extended secondary screening, hours of questioning, possible refusal/return transport and slow appeal, without execution. Higher severity here because cable adds permanent fraud-ineligibility consideration and custody-abuse reports, but division protections and existing X validity keep it from routine detention.

Lower: 0.65-A has brief hold, apology/compensation and courts reliably ordering release. Here federal refusal/permanent-ineligibility risk, federal facilities bar and documented custody abuse are not shown to be reliably remedied, despite stronger division anti-discrimination law.

Materially lower: 0.85-A has explicit equality law, respectful border inspection, independent oversight and compensation. Division law resembles that locally, but federal document, entry and custody regimes override it at first and last encounters, removing the anchor's near-uniform protection.

parsed.synthesis: Interaction dominates: division law makes hotels, shops, transport, clinics and division services comparatively safe and offers hate-crime and shield-law recourse, assuming the visitor is admitted. Federal entry screening can refuse on discrepancy and trigger fraud/permanent-ineligibility analysis, federal facilities exclude by identity, and federal custody carries documented severe abuse. Those federal exposures are unavoidable, potentially severe, and not cancelled by division law; litigation creates uncertainty rather than reliable real-time remedy. Hence mid-Elevated/Reduced boundary.
